paper_metadata.title: A Unified Model for Injection-Locked Frequency Dividers
paper_metadata.abstract: Injection-locked frequency dividers (ILFDs) are versatile analog circuit blocks used, for example, within phase-locked loops (PLLs). An important attribute is substantially lower power consumption relative to their digital counterparts. The model described in this paper unifies the treatment of injection-locked and regenerative systems.
